label: Very lean — normal for idle and light cruise
description: Maximum fuel efficiency. Clean exhaust. Smoke: Clear.

label: Lean — normal for moderate driving
description: Clean exhaust. Good efficiency. Normal under moderate load. Smoke: Clear.

label: Moderate — good power zone for diesel
description: Normal under load. Slight haze possible on hard acceleration. Smoke: Slight haze on tip-in.

label: High-load cruise — acceptable under load
description: Cummins forum / HP Academy consensus puts lambda 1.24+ as no-smoke. Lambda 1.2 is the edge of smoke-free under load; tip-in puffs are normal here. Smoke: Possible tip-in puff under heavy load.

label: Smoke begins — visible haze under load
description: Per HP Academy / Schiller: visible haze begins here. Race builds with good atomization can still be clean; stock engines visibly smoke. Smoke: Visible haze; race builds may stay clean if injector timing + boost are right.

label: Over-fueled — heavy black smoke
description: Wasting fuel. High EGTs. Power is air-limited, not fuel-limited. Smoke: Heavy black smoke.

label: DANGER — excess fuel cannot burn
description: Extreme smoke and EGTs. Engine damage risk. Reduce fuel immediately. Smoke: Extreme — unburned fuel in exhaust.
